column3: ## Admin - Flags Notifications
Setup: If you haven't performed previous test (Admin - Add, Edit, Resolve) prepare the Journal by following all the steps; otherwise you may omit steps 2-9
Navigate to /testdrive/flags
In a separate tab login as LordWiggleworth__<id> (admin)
Feline Aerodynamics Review - an update request assigned to you, with no flags
Click Add Flag button
Assign "ProfessorQuibbleton__<id>"
Add deadline in exactly 1 week
In the text area add the flag's note (any text)
Save application, Unlock & Close the form
Log out
In a separate tab log in as "ProfessorQuibbleton__<id>"

column3: Hover over Notifications button

column4: At the top of the list new notification "New flag" is listed

column3: Click on the "New flag" notification

column4: The form of the "Feline Aerodynamics Review __<id>" journal is opened in a new tab

column3: Unlock & Close the form, close the tab
Click the Notifications button at the top navigation bar

column4: At the top of the list "New flag" notification is displayed.
The long description says "A new flag in 'Feline Aerodynamics Review __<id>' has been assigned to you"

column3: Open the testdrive/flags page do not close the page where you are logged in
Click "Run background task" button located at the bottom of the testdrive page, wait for the task to execute
Go back to the tab where you are logged as ProfessorQuibbleton
refresh the page
navigate to /dashboard/notifications if not already there
